svg.title: High platelet count: repeat the count, look for the common reactive causes (infection or inflammation, iron deficiency or bleeding, hemolysis) and treat them, and only if it persists consider a clonal cause, essential thrombocythemia or primary myelofibrosis; pancytopenia is sorted into low production, high destruction or sequestration

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Platelets ≥ 450 × 10⁹/L (extreme ≥ 1000): is it REAL, REACTIVE or CLONAL?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · REPEAT the CBC: is it persistent? · spurious (rare): red cell fragments, cryoglobulins, bacteria counted as platelets

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: history + exam look for reactive AND clonal causes together

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ALL three LOW (pancytopenia)? ↓ production (marrow) · ↑ destruction (immune, drugs, infection) · big spleen

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · REACTIVE: far more COMMON · look first

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: also: hyposplenism (splenectomy, sickle cell) · non-blood cancer · rebound after myelosuppression

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: treat the cause, then REPEAT the CBC: still high → CLONAL

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: which other line is up? Hb ↑↑ → ERYTHROCYTOSIS chart · WBC ↑↑,
